acceptanceCriteria: The root cause is identified: why a PR that edited a pinned subject reached main without the repin (a merge-order race, a CI subset, or both).
A PR that changes any pinned receipt subject fails before merge with the list of receipts to repin, or the receipt model no longer breaks on subject edits without weakening UCV0-004.
The repin procedure is documented, or a script does it.
body: Filed 2026-09-25. Main went red three times after a merge because a use-case receipt under conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/ pins by SHA-256 a spec or code file that the merged PR had edited; TestUCV0ProfileMigration then fails with subject-digest-mismatch. The repins were b6726f44, #182 and #193. The same day, PRs #204 and #205 each failed their own CI after merging main and needed hand repins (the DCW spec in three contract receipts, cmd/corvint/affected.go in the UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE implementation receipt). Each repin updates the subject sha256, repositoryRevision and the ledger receipt digest by hand. UCV0-004 requires exact-byte pins, so the gap is in process. V1-0233 covers the DCW-spec case only.
title: use-case receipts pin spec and code bytes, so merging a PR that edits a pinned subject turns main red
